title: Discovery Engine: `autoModelId` Now Output-Only; Sobi Task Tracking Added
summary: A breaking change makes the `autoModelId` property in `WidgetConfigUiSettingsModelConfigInfo` read-only. Additionally, `FeedbackConversationInfo` now includes `taskName` for tracking Sobi long-running agent tasks, and `completeQuery` methods see scope reordering.
details:
The `autoModelId` property within the `GoogleCloudDiscoveryengineV1WidgetConfigUiSettingsModelConfigInfo` schema has been marked as `Output only`. This is a breaking change: if your integration was previously setting this field, it will now fail. This field is intended to provide the `model_id` to use when an end-user selects an 'Auto' option in the UI, and is now server-managed.

On the positive side, the `GoogleCloudDiscoveryengineV1FeedbackConversationInfo` schema gains a new optional `taskName` property. This allows developers to associate conversation feedback with the full resource name of a Sobi long-running agent task, providing better traceability.

Finally, the `completeQuery` methods across various `completionConfig` resources have had their authentication scopes reordered. While `cloud-platform` is still supported, `cloud_search.query` is now listed as the primary scope, encouraging more granular permission usage.
